title: Look What You Made Me Do: Discerning Feature for Classification of Endocrine-Disrupting Chemical Binding to Steroid Hormone Receptors.
authors: Rashidian, Azam; Pitkanen, Sini; Maltarollo, Vinicius Goncalves; Schoppmeier, Ulrich; Shevchenko, Ekaterina; Medarametla, Prasanthi; Poso, Antti; Kublbeck, Jenni; Honkakoski, Paavo; Kronenberger, Thales
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究内分泌干扰物与类固醇激素受体（蛋白-配体）的结合分类，虽非TF-DNA体系，但MD结合特征分析方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模，故给予中档分。
abstract: Exposure to metabolism-disrupting chemicals, which are a specific type of endocrine-disrupting chemical (EDC), is linked to metabolic problems such as dyslipidemia, insulin resistance, and hepatic steatosis. Steroid hormone receptors (SHRs) within the nuclear receptor superfamily are well-known targets for EDCs in reproductive tissues and, to a lesser extent, in liver. In this study, we investigated how five well-established SHR ligands and eight EDCs including pesticides, plasticizers, pharmaceuticals, flame retardants, industrial chemicals, and their metabolites affect estrogen (ERalpha in reproductive tissues) and glucocorticoid (GR in liver) receptors. We investigated the utility of structural molecular modeling to classify EDC binding to ERalpha and GR. To this end, we modeled a set of EDC binding to ER and GR using unbiased all-atom long-time scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and compared them against known established SHR agonists and antagonists. We systematically evaluated MD-derived variables such as protein-ligand interactions and binding energy, folding secondary structure elements, distances, and angles as relevant parameters. Our findings suggest that the well-established H12 folding and conformational angles can be discerning features for binding of EDCs to SHRs. Although SHR activation often involves changes in H12 folding and geometry, GR displayed less flexibility in this region, suggesting that protein-ligand interaction and binding energy are more relevant for its classification. We show that MD simulations combined with experimental assays can be a useful tool for studying novel EDCs by providing relevant structural features for their classification.
abstract_zh: 接触代谢干扰化学物质（metabolism-disrupting chemicals）是内分泌干扰化学物质（endocrine-disrupting chemical, EDC）的一种特定类型，与代谢问题如血脂异常、胰岛素抵抗和肝脂肪变性相关。核受体超家族中的类固醇激素受体（steroid hormone receptors, SHRs）是EDC在生殖组织中的已知靶点，在肝脏中作用程度较低。在本研究中，我们探讨了五种公认的SHR配体及八种EDC（包括农药、增塑剂、药物、阻燃剂、工业化学品及其代谢物）如何影响雌激素受体（ERα，在生殖组织中）和糖皮质激素受体（GR，在肝脏中）。我们研究了结构分子建模在分类EDC与ERα和GR结合中的实用性。为此，我们使用无偏全原子长时间尺度分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，对一组EDC与ER和GR的结合进行了建模，并将其与已知的SHR激动剂和拮抗剂进行比较。我们系统评估了MD衍生变量，如蛋白质-配体相互作用和结合能、折叠二级结构元素、距离和角度作为相关参数。我们的发现表明，公认的H12折叠和构象角度可作为EDC与SHRs结合的分辨特征。尽管SHR激活通常涉及H12折叠和几何结构的变化，但GR在该区域表现出较小的灵活性，这表明蛋白质-配体相互作用和结合能对其分类更为相关。我们证明，MD模拟结合实验测定，通过提供相关结构特征，可成为研究新型EDC的有用工具。
